title: A Chess Punch 🥊
transcript: Fools will resign. Wise players will make a draw, but only a true genius will be able to win from this position. You see the pressure on the H file seems crushing and it seems like black is winning, but actually after any simple trade like rook takes H6, the pressure is much less and this is actually a drawn position and white has to somehow address this pressure on the white king. Except he doesn't because in this position there is an incredible win starting with B5. Now if the king takes all of a sudden the queen is open and deliver this checkmate in two moves. But of course black can simply take with the B pawn, but white pulls up his leaves and sucker punches black with queen to A5. An incredible sacrifice. The pawn is pinned by the rook so the black king has to take, but now of course rook to A7 is a beautiful checkmate.
